description: GET ONLY the 'PlatformBridge' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel. Platform bridge - what the game takes from the player's idosgames.com account and what it lets players show on their public profile. Profile: Off / Default (unset: the platform name and avatar until the player renames themselves in the game) / Always (every platform login overwrites them). Friends: TitleOnly (unset) / TitleAndPlatform (plus mutual follows on idosgames.com whose both sides play this game) / PlatformOnly (only those; in-game friend requests are refused) - applies to EVERY friends-based system: friends list and leaderboard, gifts, attack targets, friends-only Workshop items, recommendations. Notifications: which in-game notifications (Attack, Raid, FriendAdded, WorkshopSale) also reach the idosgames.com notification bell; empty = none. Guests never get platform data; the economy never crosses the bridge; turning the bridge off deletes nothing.
name: get_platform_bridge
title: Get Platform Bridge settings
